jobs.title: Presales Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Simpson Associates transforms raw data into actionable insights that drive positive change.

Our Microsoft data expertise, our specialist sector knowledge, plus our innovative and trusted advice and guidance are just some of the reasons clients choose to work with us.

Our mission is to help purpose-led organisations from within the public and private sectors to harness data as a lever for change and enable them to realise business value more quickly. We provide the full range of services to support organisations on their data transformation journey. From advisory support and data strategy, to developing Data & AI solutions, right through to providing a range of managed services.

We are a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Cloud & AI Platforms and Security, holding Specialisations in AI Platform on Microsoft Azure, Build AI Apps on Microsoft Azure, Analytics on Microsoft Azure and Data Warehouse Migration to Microsoft Azure. Previously, Cloud & AI platforms were individual pillars for Data & AI, Digital & App innovation and Infrastructure.

But it's not just about the badges. We are proud to be recognised as the winner of the 2024 Microsoft Community Response Partner of the Year award, reflecting our dedication to using technology for positive change. We are also a Databricks partner, and an IBM Gold Partner, specialising in Cognos Analytics and Planning Analytics.

With offices in York and Sheffield, and a team based throughout the UK – we champion creativity, innovation and collaboration in the workplace.

The Role

As a Presales Solutions Consultant, you will be a leading technical authority to deliver high-quality, credible technical responses that drive new business, improve win rates, and support revenue growth. You will collaborate closely with the Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to ensure that technical proposals align with client needs and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Proposals and Advisory: Presales Solutions Consultants will contribute to, and oversee, the creation and review of technical responses e.g. RFPs, RFIs; support the Sales function in customer meetings both in person and online to drive outcomes; and advise in a strategic advisory capacity for our customers to grow the business. You will ensure that the proposals you prepare are both technically accurate and strategically aligned with our ambitions, working closely with the bid co-ordinator in the case of formal processes.

Development of New and Evolving Offerings: Presales Solutions Consultants will collaborate with the CTO, sales, product, marketing, and delivery teams to drive the development of new offerings and refine existing solutions. This includes ensuring that all associated sales and marketing collateral is up-to-date, relevant, and aligned with market needs. You will work closely with these teams to ensure that offerings are not only technically sound but also positioned effectively to resonate with clients and differentiate Simpson Associates.

Knowledge Sharing and Training: Presales Solutions Consultants will ensure they stay up to date with the latest technical developments, product knowledge, and industry trends. Additionally you will share your knowledge and development opportunities with the team, ensuring they too have the skills needed to excel in their roles.

Outreach, Promotion and Representation: Presales Solutions Consultants as a technical authority in the business will support with promotion activities to new and existing customers considering webinars, our monthly forum, our YouTube channel and contributions to our website. In addition, you will support events when required such as roundtables, hacks, and conferences.

Skills & Attributes Required

Consulting – a core focus is on consultative selling.
Demonstrable experience of gathering requirements and turning them into technical solutions.
Able to explain complex analytical methodologies and concepts in non-technical language.
Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Understanding of the commercial impact of technology solutions, ensuring proposals align with customer business objectives and ROI considerations.

Technical – the second focus is on technical ability to demonstrate credibility to our customers.
You must possess experience in at least one of the following technologies: Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Purview, MDM solutions, Integration solutions, Data Virtualisation solutions,
And at least one of the following domains: Advisory, Infrastructure & Security, Enterprise and Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Integration, Data Management, Data Governance, Data Analytics, Data Science & AI, Application Development, Managed Services.

Project Delivery – the final focus is on realistic planning, estimation and pricing of our projects.
Previous experience in leading project delivery, developing and executing project plans.
Previous experience in project effort estimation and supporting pricing.
Ability to understand how to structure and phase project plans based on available information.
Understanding of typical customer roles, responsibilities and tasks required to support the project; captured as project prerequisites, built into the plan or described via a RACI.
Recognition of project risks and assumptions in estimations and project plans.

Due to the nature of our work, successful candidates will be required to obtain relevant security clearance.

Simpson Associates reserves the right to close the advert at anytime.

jobs.title: Senior Forecasting & Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
About Branch

Branch is shaking up the $46B office products industry to create the best work experience for the 21st century: easy, affordable and adaptable so you can sit down (or stand) and get to work.

Most people spend eight hours a day at their workspace. Our mission is creating accessible and inspiring products to help people and teams feel their best at work, wherever that happens.

We're based in NYC and Toronto, and backed by the investors behind Quip, Caraway, Eight Sleep and Peloton. Our culture combines strategic clarity with scrappy execution; we think and plan rigorously but ship fast and have fun doing it. We're looking for entrepreneurial teammates who do the same.

About The Role

We're growing our Forecasting & Planning team to support the business's increasingly complex channel mix — most notably our rapidly scaling Enterprise/B2B business. This role sits upstream of tactical execution, focused on strategic demand planning, cross-functional partnership, and channel-specific ownership. You'll partner closely with the Senior Manager and a Forecasting Analyst to build the planning function's next chapter.

This role is salaried with a compensation range of $85,000-$95,000 based on the candidate's experience, skills, competencies, qualifications and market.

What You'll Own

Enterprise/B2B channel planning: Serve as the primary forecasting and planning owner for the Enterprise channel, partnering directly with Sales and Account Management to translate pipeline and account-level signals into demand forecasts
Strategic demand planning: Own the higher-level forecasting methodology and assumptions feeding the overall revenue forecast (DTC, Enterprise, Amazon, Wholesale), stepping back from day-to-day tactical placement to focus on scenario planning, risk-flagging, and forecast accuracy improvement
Tooling & automation: Build and maintain BigQuery-based data pulls, automate recurring reporting/forecasting workflows, and apply AI tools to speed up analysis — reducing manual, spreadsheet-dependent processes over time
S&OP-style cross-functional partnership: Represent planning in cross-functional forecast reviews with Sales, Finance, and Product; translate business context into planning assumptions and vice versa
New product introduction (NPI) planning: Partner with Product Development on demand forecasting for new launches, building forecast logic for products with no historical sell-through
Product lifecycle strategy: Own the strategic view of lifecycle management — discontinuation timing, overstock/understock risk, and recommendations tied to broader merchandising strategy (with room to grow into deeper merch collaboration as the team scales)
Process & methodology improvement: Identify and implement improvements to forecasting models, planning cadences, and tools as the team's complexity grows
Strategic analysis: Contribute ad hoc analysis supporting business-wide decisions (assortment, channel investment, inventory strategy)

What Success Looks Like

Shared Accountability With The Team On

MAPE: ≤10% across all channels (with specific ownership of Enterprise channel accuracy)
In-Stock Rate: 95% combined / 98% on Enterprise All-Star SKUs / 98% on Top 5 SKUs
DIO: contributing to inventory efficiency through better upstream forecast quality
Average Parcel Zone: supporting network/inventory placement decisions that improve transit speed and cost

What You Bring

5–7 years of experience in demand planning, merchandising planning, or forecasting, ideally with prior experience in a formal planner-type role
Experience with B2B/non-DTC planning is a strong asset (account-based, pipeline-driven, or lumpy-demand forecasting)
Comfort operating strategically and upstream — someone who can build a point of view on "what should the forecast assume" rather than just executing against a set plan
Strong cross-functional communication skills; comfortable presenting forecasts and recommendations to non-planning stakeholders
Bonus: experience with NPI forecasting or product lifecycle management

Technical Skills (high priority)

This role requires someone who can build and own tools, not just operate within them:

BI tools: Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or Looker — building dashboards and reports from scratch, not just consuming them
SQL / BigQuery: Comfortable writing and optimizing queries to pull and model data directly from the warehouse, reducing dependency on other teams for data access
Automation: Track record of automating manual, repetitive planning processes (e.g., scripting recurring reports, automating data refreshes, building repeatable forecast pipelines) rather than rebuilding spreadsheets each cycle
AI/LLM tools: Hands-on experience applying AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate analysis, generate code/scripts, summarize data, or build forecasting logic
Advanced Excel: Experience with complex modeling, but not the primary tool for scaled work
Python or similar scripting experience is a strong asset, particularly for automation or forecast modeling

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
BigTime is seeking a dynamic Solutions Consultant to join our team and play a pivotal role in aligning innovative solutions to real-world customer challenges. As a key partner to the Revenue Team, you'll help drive growth by delivering compelling demos, crafting strategic solution architectures, and acting as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle, from first discovery call through implementation handoff.

You'll work across a range of customer needs, sizes and scopes: collaborating with internal stakeholders, technical experts, and client decision-makers to shape tailored technology solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a high-performing, customer-obsessed professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative SaaS environment and wants to go deep on a real product, not just run demos off a script. Our ideal candidate has experience in a software environment in a solutions-based role and is motivated to bring AI to the forefront of their tech career.

Who is BigTime?

BigTime is the AI-powered professional services platform enabling intelligent decisions and delivering profitable growth. We've proudly been featured on Inc's 500 Fastest Growing Companies in America for 4 years in a row. BigTime Software is the engine behind the greatest professional service firms on the planet, delivering back-office time/budgeting and invoicing to over 2,500 firms worldwide and tracking over $4 billion in billable time each year. Our flagship product is a SaaS-based system that is custom-built for the professional services industry.

BigTime is a PE-backed company, headquartered out of Chicago, with offices in Chicago, Phoenix and Wroclaw, Poland. We've proudly been named on 'Crain's Best Places to Work' three years in a row. If you're motivated to join a hyper growth organization, we're eager to talk to you.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.

Company pays 100% of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance.

401k with generous company match.

Hybrid work schedule: in office 3 times a week.

Generous time off and paid company holidays.

Paid Parental Leave.

Fresh fruit, snacks, cold brew coffee/tea, soda and sparkling water.

Company provided latest technology & software tools.

A collaborative team, strong growth culture, and opportunities to make an immediate impact.

What You'll Be Accountable For:

Partner with Revenue Team to lead engaging, value-driven product demonstrations across a mix of quick discovery demos and deep technical deep-dives, tailored to deal complexity rather than a single fixed cadence.

Develop and maintain deep expertise in BigTime's own PSA, EPSA, and CPQ products, including project and budget structures, revenue recognition, and configuration options, to serve as the internal and external subject matter expert.

Lead discovery sessions with clients to surface business needs and technical requirements, and translate those into scoped solution architectures.

Build and contribute to SOWs, capability overlap analyses, and implementation scoping documents as part of the sales cycle, not just as a post-sale handoff.

Map customer objectives to product capabilities and illustrate measurable ROI through demos, documentation, and storytelling.

Maintain command of competitive positioning against key alternatives in the PSA/CPQ space and adapt demo narratives and objection handling in real time.

Act as subject matter expert on key platform integrations (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct) as they relate to BigTime's core product.

Assist with platform configuration, trials, and proof-of-concept development for prospects.

Own or co-own the handoff from sales to implementation, including documentation, requirements capture, and cross-functional coordination with the implementation team.

Identify and build practical AI-driven tooling and workflows (e.g., API integrations, automation, transcript analysis) to drive efficiency across the sales and solutions consulting function.

Collaborate cross-functionally on content creation, presentations, and enablement materials.

Produce documentation, reference materials, and knowledge base content to support pre- and post-sale engagements.

Contribute to internal enablement and external thought leadership (webinars, white papers, etc.).

What You Bring:

2+ years of experience in a SaaS Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or related role.

Strong understanding of CRM (Salesforce or similar), finance/accounting platforms, and/or project management tools.

Comfort working with APIs, scripting, or agentic AI tools to build practical solutions, not just enthusiasm for AI as a concept.

Proficient in crafting and delivering personalized software demonstrations that tell a compelling story.

Ability to produce clear, structured documentation (SOWs, scoping docs, capability comparisons) under deal-cycle time pressure.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a knack for translating complex concepts into user-friendly language.

Strategic problem-solver with a customer-first mindset and a bias for action.

Self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly, and operates with a strong sense of ownership.

Bonus Points For:

Experience supporting professional services firms or finance teams.

Familiarity with integrations like Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Jira, or Salesforce.

Experience with PSA, ERP, or CPQ platforms specifically, rather than general SaaS tools.

The expected salary for this position ranges from $80,000 to $90,000 annually. The actual salary will be determined on an individualized basis, taking into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, education, and, where applicable, licenses or certifications held. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, this position may be eligible for additional types of compensation such as bonuses.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. BigTime Software, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Your Right to Work: in compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa or STEM OPT at this time.
